title: Teal-haired Character Poses
description: Four nearly identical standing poses of a young male character with teal spiky hair, displayed side by side. He wears a layered purple and teal outfit with a star-emblem belt, dark patterned cape, and matching boots, shown in a walking stance against a plain gray background.
prompt: A young male anime character with spiky teal hair and purple eyes, wearing a cropped purple jacket over a teal sash and pants, black cape with teal lining and star patterns, fingerless gloves, and star-decorated boots.
